items.title: Chief Legal Officer / Head of Legal
items.description: We are looking for an experienced CLO / Head of Legal to take ownership of the legal function within an international iGaming business operating across multiple markets. This is a business-oriented leadership role covering licensing, corporate matters, contracts, compliance, data protection, and legal risk management. The Head of Legal will work directly with senior management and help turn regulatory requirements and legal risks into practical solutions that support business growth. Responsibilities - Lead legal and regulatory support across existing and new markets, including iGaming license applications, renewals and expansion, regulatory reporting, communication with authorities, and coordination with local legal advisers - Assess requirements for new jurisdictions, covering gambling regulation, local presence, taxation, advertising and promotions, while monitoring legislative changes and translating them into practical requirements for the business - Oversee the group’s corporate structure, including entity incorporation and maintenance, ownership changes, intercompany arrangements, substance matters, and related KYC and tax considerations in cooperation with the CFO - Support relationships with banks, EMIs, and corporate service providers, including account opening and ongoing corporate and compliance matters - Own the full contracting function across gaming and payment providers, aggregators, KYC/anti-fraud and SaaS vendors, affiliates, media partners, employment/B2B relationships, NDAs, and IP matters; develop standardized templates and internal approval procedures - Oversee AML/CFT, KYC/KYB, sanctions compliance, GDPR and other applicable data protection requirements, working closely with the MLRO, Security, and relevant business teams - Provide legal oversight of responsible gaming requirements and customer-facing documentation, including Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policies, bonus terms, promotional rules, age restrictions, and self-exclusion - Manage legal disputes and asset protection matters, including player claims, ADR, regulatory complaints, chargebacks, payment-provider disputes, debt recovery, trademarks, domains, phishing, and unauthorized brand use - Coordinate external law firms and advisers, managing scope, quality, and legal spend, as well as budgets related to licensing and registration - Build and develop the internal Legal function through hiring, mentoring, and allocation of responsibilities, while acting as a business partner to executive leadership and providing practical solutions alongside legal risk assessments Requirements - 5+ years of hands-on legal practice in the iGaming sector, whether within an operator, platform provider, or industry-focused law firm; at least 2 years should include responsibility for leading the legal function or working independently as the sole in-house lawyer - A completed university-level legal education and a strong foundation in cross-border corporate and private international law, including international structures, conflict-of-law principles, jurisdiction and governing-law matters, and international contractual arrangements - Practical exposure to the regulatory side of online gambling, with a clear understanding of operator obligations and licensing frameworks such as Curaçao, Malta, Anjouan, or comparable jurisdictions - Strong knowledge of the commercial and legal specifics of iGaming, including contractual relationships with gaming and payment providers and the regulatory implications associated with bonus mechanics - Proven competence in AML/KYC and GDPR matters as they apply specifically to online gambling operations - Extensive contract ownership experience: able to independently prepare documentation, assess legal terms, negotiate directly with counterparties, and bring agreements through to completion - Ability to operate effectively when legislation or regulatory guidance does not provide a straightforward answer, assessing legal exposure while finding solutions that remain workable for the business - Languages proficiency: C1+ English for independent work in an international legal environment, including negotiations, contract drafting and correspondence; fluent/native Russian for effective communication with the team, key stakeholders and management. Would be a plus - First-hand involvement in taking an iGaming licence from initial application through to approval - Experience advising on the legal aspects of cryptocurrency-based payment flows - Familiarity with the rules governing gambling advertising and promotion across relevant jurisdictions - Professional qualification or admission to legal practice in one of the applicable jurisdictions What's in it for you - A senior-level role with the opportunity to influence decisions around new markets, products, and the broader business strategy - Freedom to build the Legal function around your own approach, defining its structure, internal processes, and future team setup - Flexible working arrangements with a choice between remote and hybrid formats, plus relocation assistance where needed - Resources to engage external legal expertise when required, alongside support for continuous professional development through training, certifications, and industry events - Competitive compensation tailored to the candidate’s experience and discussed individually during the hiring process - Paid vacation and sick leave, as well as compensation for work equipment

items.title: Service Operations Manager
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE The Service Operations Manager is responsible for the reliable, continuous delivery of production monitoring and identity & access management services across LeoVegas. The role combines people leadership of a shift-based engineering team with operational ownership of access governance, ensuring both functions run with consistency, discipline, and clear escalation paths. This is a people-first leadership role. The manager owns team health, shift rhythm, process adherence, and cross-functional coordination, serving as the primary operational liaison between Service Operations and the rest of the Technical Operations department. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: Operational leadership & shift management - Own the day-to-day running of a 24/7 shift-based monitoring operation, ensuring handovers are structured and documented. - Maintain shift coverage, manage rota planning, and oversee escalation readiness at all times. - Act as the primary point of escalation for shift engineers during major incidents, supporting war room coordination and live documentation. - Ensure production monitoring activities align with agreed SLAs, detection standards, and escalation procedures. - Review and continuously improve shift handover quality, ensuring knowledge transfer between rotations. Identity & access management oversight - Oversee the onboarding and offboarding process for all company employees, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant access provisioning. - Ensure periodic access reviews are completed on schedule across all managed systems. - Maintain compliance with internal access policies and relevant regulatory requirements (MGA, UKGC, SPA, and others as applicable). - Act as the accountable owner for access governance, working with the Identity & Access Analysts to continuously improve procedures. Cross-functional coordination - Serve as the primary interface between Service Operations and the Incident Management function, ensuring events are correctly escalated, classified, and handed over. - Coordinate with Change Management on maintenance windows, PR reviews, and go-live readiness activities. - Work closely with the Observability & Engineering Manager to surface operational pain points, monitoring gaps, and manual toil that require tooling or automation investment. - Participate in new market and provider onboarding processes, maintaining checklists and ensuring regulatory notification requirements are met. People & performance management - Lead regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and development planning for all direct reports. - Manage team wellbeing and engagement, with particular attention to the challenges of shift-based working patterns. - Identify training needs and support certification or skills development where appropriate. - Onboard new team members effectively, maintaining and improving onboarding documentation. Process & governance - Own and maintain operational runbooks, escalation playbooks, and standard operating procedures for the Service Operations team. - Ensure all monitoring activities comply with the Datadog governance standards set by the Observability & Engineering team. - Support certification readiness activities by ensuring operational processes meet required compliance standards. - Conduct or facilitate post-shift reviews following major incidents, feeding findings into the wider incident management process. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: The essentials skills you bring to the team: - Proven experience managing a shift-based operations or NOC team in a 24/7 environment. - Strong understanding of production monitoring principles, event management, and incident escalation. - Experience managing identity & access management processes, including onboarding, offboarding, and access reviews. - Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a team of 8+ people across multiple disciplines. - Familiarity with ITIL frameworks, particularly Service Operation and Incident Management practices. - Strong communication skills, able to represent operational concerns clearly to senior stakeholders. Nice to have: - Previous experience in an iGaming, fintech, or regulated technology environment. - Hands-on experience with Datadog or equivalent observability platforms. - ITIL Foundation certification or above. - Experience working across multiple regulatory jurisdictions (SGA, MGA, UKGC, ADM, etc.). WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Applied AI, Forward Deployed Machine Learning Engineer - (Internship)
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As an Applied Engineering Intern, you will work closely with our Applied AI Engineering team to facilitate the adoption of Mistral AI products among customers and collaborate with them to address complex technical challenges. This role is based in Paris, with an internship duration of 6 months. We are open to CIFRE programs as a continuation after the internship. What you will do • Contribute to the deployment of state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving technological transformation with our customers. • Collaborate with researchers, AI engineers, and product engineers on complex customer projects. • Work with the product and science team to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback. How We Work in Applied AI - We care about people and outputs. - What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it - Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week. - Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before - We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care. - No politics. Low ego, high standards. - We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it. About you • You are currently pursuing a degree in AI, data science, or a related field from a tier 1 engineering school or university. • You have strong programming skills in Python. • You are familiar with machine learning algorithms and natural language processing techniques. • You hold basic understanding of MLOps and deploying machine learning use cases. • You have good communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ideally you have: • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch. • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and Linux shell environment. • Experience working in HPC Environments • Publication record in AI or a related field Location & work authorization: This internship is available only in France. Please apply only if you have the required work authorization to complete the internship in the relevant country for its full duration. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption. You will collaborate closely with customer teams to ship advanced AI applications that solve real world business problems. Our FDEs engage with customers to accelerate the adoption of existing products and create new applications built on our models. Working closely with our Post-Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and serve as one of our founding FDEs who helps to shape our forward-deployed motion. We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive under ambiguity, and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. This is a significant responsibility: you’ll play a key role in championing our mission in the enterprise. Responsibilities Work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring that these products meet customer requirements. Deliver technical artifacts for customers like MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills that will be used in production workflows. Provide white glove deployment support for Anthropic products in enterprise environments. Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams. Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks. Build long term relationships with customers and proactively identify new opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement. Travel frequently (25-50%) to customer sites to build in person with customers. Be a champion for Anthropic’s mission in the field. You May Be a Good Fit If You Have 4+ years of experience in a technical, customer facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, or as a Software Engineer with consulting or product experience. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply. Production experience with LLMs including advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale. Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python (and ideally in one or more additional languages like TypeScript, Java, etc) and experience shipping production applications High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity present in complex organizations. High cooperation mindset for cross-organizational collaboration, balancing competing priorities with integrity. Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications. Strong communication skills to conduct discovery with customers and to convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders while maintaining a low ego and collaborative approach. A background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical is a plus. Experience with enterprise IT systems and/or AI deployment patterns is a plus. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £225,000 — £255,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Senior Platform Core DevOps Engineer - Infra
items.description: Are you an ambitious Senior DevOps Engineer eager to jump in a world of complex challenges to modernise web and globally distributed applications? We are hiring! A taster of what you will be involved with Working with cutting edge technology enabling our Cloud Journey The Platform Core team is responsible for managing Infrastructure as Code for parts of our Core Platform Layer (Kubernetes Clusters, Message Broker backends, Infrastructure tooling), providing a distributed runtime platform that ensures optimal performance of our business web applications, APIs and backend services Building our Infrastructure Platforms as self-service to our developers and providing guidance and tooling for developers to self-manage their applications cross environments Continuously improve and develop our platforms based on business needs. Analyse, diagnose and solve issues of efficiency performance and scale collaborating cross functional with colleagues from different teams Right now, we are looking to strengthen further the management of our Container Platform and Kafka Messaging Platform and looking for a DevOps engineer with strong knowledge and experience in Kubernetes administration and managing Kafka infrastructure. What we're looking for Strong knowledge and experience in setting up and administering Kubernetes clusters, preferably with experience with AWS EKS and Rancher RKE. Strong knowledge and experience of managing Kafka infrastructure in a geo-distributed setup, administration, and configuration of such service. Managing Cloud Infrastructure via Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, with a good understanding of terraform modules and workflows. Experience working with cloud providers, with AWS as preference, and strong knowledge with Cloud provider services such as EC2, ALBs, VPC, and EKS Experience in building scalable and distributed infrastructure Experience in using versioned source control to manage code changes Familiarity with the open-source monitoring stack of Prometheus/Grafana. Ability to write scripts in Python, Bash, Powershell or similar Experience in using and managing Linux distributions Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and provide effective solutions in a timely manner. Knowledge of best practices in IT operations, such as ITIL (IT Infrastructure Library) and DevOps principles. Ability to adapt to changing technologies and work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Required to be on an On-call support schedule. Who We Are Betsson Group is one of the largest companies within the Global iGaming space and can trace our heritage as far back as the 1960’s. We’re Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta. We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12+ jurisdictions and 20+ brands. items.title: B2B Marketing Manager, DACH
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption. The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership. DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI. ABOUT THE ROLE As the B2B Marketing Manager for DACH, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption. You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in DACH. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities. This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused DACH B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing. Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next. The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed. This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Own and execute the integrated DACH B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes. - Carry pipeline goals for DACH B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes. - Partner closely with DACH Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews. - Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels. - Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities. - Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations. - Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions. - Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect DACH market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations. - Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of DACH in regional planning and prioritisation. - Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders. - Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline. - Own the operating rhythm for DACH B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation. - Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with DACH customers and decision-makers. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS. - Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles. - Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys. - Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities. - Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up. - Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting. - Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity. - Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership. - Understand DACH enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions. - Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation. - Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion. - Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity. - Communicate credibly with senior customer decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—as well as Sales, Marketing, and partner stakeholders. - Are energised by AI and motivated to help organisations across DACH adopt transformative technology responsibly. - Are fluent in German and English. items.title: Marketing Lead
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? Are you obsessed with creator distribution, affiliate economics and the deals that put a brand in front of millions? Do you thrive with a blank page, where there’s no incumbent to copy and no playbook to inherit? If you’re dialled in on internet culture and crypto communities and you want the scope to build a brand from near-zero, this is a real opportunity to join one of Australia’s fastest growing tech companies, working across the world’s most talked about products. What you’ll build with us: This role owns affiliate and creator distribution end to end for a new betting product on our roadmap. You’ll own the partner base and the commercial terms behind it: recruitment, revenue-share structures, tooling and performance management, plus the YouTube, X and streaming partnerships that put the product in front of a crypto-native audience. You’ll also own the acquisition funnel and the P&L underneath it, so every dollar is attributable and every call is defensible. You’ll inherit real advantages: a founder-backed product, a strong engineering bench, and access to one of the most effective creator distribution networks in the world through our existing brands. What you won’t inherit is a playbook. The edge on offer here is scope — building at a scale most marketers never touch, with the resources to actually do it. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify, Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Own one of our affiliate and creator programmes end to end – recruitment, commercial terms, revenue-share structures, tooling and performance management of the partner base Sign and scale YouTube, X and streaming partnerships with crypto and internet-culture creators, from long-form YouTube integrations through to always-on affiliate relationships Negotiate deals that hold up commercially – you’ll model the economics, not just do the deal Build the distribution flywheel deliberately, including where we can leverage our existing creator ecosystem, while making sure the product lands as its own brand with its own audience Own the full acquisition funnel and the P&L behind it – budget, channel mix, CAC, deposit conversion and payback Build and scale acquisition across the channels that actually work for a crypto-native audience Set the measurement stack with BI and product analytics so every dollar is attributable and every decision is defensible Partner with CRM to build the onboarding, activation and retention journeys that turn a first deposit into an active player, and know which cohorts are worth reactivating and which aren’t Set and enforce the standards our affiliates and creators market to – their content is our brand and our regulatory exposure Your track record: Significant demonstrated experience leading affiliates, partnerships or growth for a high-growth consumer product Proven track record building and scaling affiliate programmes and creator or influencer partnerships, with YouTube partnerships specifically a strong advantage Genuine fluency in the crypto space – you understand the culture, the channels and the community, and you can tell the difference between real signal and noise Commercial ownership of a marketing budget with hard accountability for CAC, LTV, payback and revenue Strong analytical capability – comfortable in the data, able to interrogate attribution and make a call under uncertainty Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to sell a strategy to an executive audience and a partnership to a creator Commercially ruthless – every channel, creator and deal earns its place in the mix, you kill what isn’t working fast and you can show the numbers behind the call Straight about risk – you understand that credibility is the growth strategy, you market honestly and you hold every partner to the same line Bonus points if you also have: Knowledge of iGaming, sports betting or casino environments and their affiliate economics Experience marketing high-risk products in a restricted-advertising environment Experience taking a product to market internationally across multiple jurisdictions and licensing regimes Additional language skills Tertiary qualifications in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field Here are our benefits and perks: Sharpening your edge The ultimate sandbox. Exciting, on-the-job learning opportunities. 1 in 3 of our people level up their roles every year. If you deliver, you move. Competitive pay and bonus scheme Market-synced pay that respects your craft and location. Performance-based bonus recognition based on your impact (up to 20%). Help us build our crew and get paid for it with our high-value referral bonus. Because great people know great people. Other perks 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers Smooth Parental Return: Ease back into work with 12 weeks of transition support, including fully paid Fridays off during your first three months back Access to Employee Assistance Program Wednesday massages In-house baristas serve you free coffee, fresh juices and smoothies. Daily catered breakfast and regular company-wide events. Snack walls and drink fridges on every floor. Fun, modern office spaces. Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles and an F1 simulator. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The APAC team is responsible for bringing OpenAI’s mission, products, and partnerships to life across one of the company’s most strategically important regions. As we scale our presence across Asia-Pacific, we are building a regional operating model that enables strong local execution, consistent global alignment, and long-term impact across businesses, products, markets, and functions. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Lead to lead and scale operational excellence in Korea. Reporting to the General Manager, Korea, this leader will work hand in hand with the General Manager to translate global strategy into regional execution, ensure operating discipline across markets and functions, and help the business scale with consistency, speed, and rigor. This person will act as a key bridge between global leadership and regional teams, bringing clarity to priorities, building scalable operating systems, and ensuring the region is set up to deliver against ambitious business goals while keeping the long-term opportunity in mind. This role is based in Seoul, Korea and we use a hybrid model of 3 days in office. YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Defining and implementing the Korea operating strategy in alignment with APAC & global objectives and regional priorities. - Driving execution across key markets, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs, regulations, and market dynamics. - Partnering with global leadership to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and ensure strong execution in-region. - Establishing KPIs, reporting frameworks, and operating cadences to track performance and inform decision-making. - Building and optimizing scalable processes across business lines, including consumer, product, partnerships, and other key functions. - Identifying operational gaps and inefficiencies, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. - Supporting market entry strategies and operational readiness for Korea - Enabling strategic partnerships through strong operational frameworks and close partnership with relevant teams. - Helping build a strong regional functional leadership team and ensuring the regional operating system runs smoothly and efficiently. - Collaborating closely across functions to drive accountability and deliver against regional goals. - Ensuring seamless coordination between global and regional stakeholders. - Acting as a central point of accountability for operational delivery across Korea. - Building, leading, and mentoring a high-performing regional operations team. - Fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, operational rigor, and continuous learning. - Developing leadership bench strength across key markets and functions. WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WITH: - Significant experience leading regional or international operations in a fast-scaling, complex business environment. - Strong strategic and operational judgment, with the ability to translate high-level goals into clear execution plans. - Experience operating across multiple markets, functions, and business lines, ideally within Korea. - A track record of building scalable operating systems, processes, metrics, and reporting frameworks. - Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across global and regional teams. - Excellent business judgment, with a bias toward action and strong accountability for outcomes. - Experience supporting market expansion, operational readiness, and/or regional growth initiatives. - Strong people leadership skills, including experience building and developing high-performing teams. - Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure in fast-moving environments. - High integrity, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bring clarity to complex topics. items.title: Doctorant·e CIFRE Data Science Personnalisation et Jeu Responsable F/H
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic est un acteur européen majeur du pari sportif et du jeu en ligne, proposant des activités de paris sportifs, de poker, de courses hippiques et de casino sur plusieurs marchés. Notre mission est de faire grandir la passion du sport et du jeu en proposant une expérience de divertissement innovante, dans un environnement sécurisé et responsable. Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis dans cinq pays et un siège basé à Bordeaux, Betclic est une entreprise internationale, moderne et profondément technologique. Chez Betclic, la Data n’est pas une fonction support : des dizaines de modèles et de produits data tournent en production et contribuent directement à l’expérience de millions de joueurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe Data Science de plus de dix personnes, dont quatre docteurs, qui travaille au quotidien avec les équipes Produit, Engineering, MLOps et Jeu Responsable. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 Cette opportunité combine un programme de recherche ambitieux avec un environnement industriel concret : • Une thèse CIFRE de 3 ans avec un CDI dès l’embauche • Un sujet de recherche directement lié au jeu responsable et à des décisions produit concrètes • Des données comportementales et transactionnelles à grande échelle, des systèmes de recommandation en production et un environnement d’expérimentation • Un environnement international et créatif dans lequel la Data Science a un impact visible • Un accès à Claude et une culture encourageant l’usage responsable de l’IA générative pour la recherche, le prototypage, l’analyse et la rédaction ENTER THE GAME 🎮 En tant que doctorant·e CIFRE, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Data Science de Betclic et travaillerez sur un sujet à l’intersection de la modélisation séquentielle, de la personnalisation, des sciences comportementales et du jeu responsable. La thèse sera menée en partenariat avec le laboratoire IMS Bordeaux et l’ENSC Bordeaux INP. Le ou la doctorant·e sera inscrit·e à l’école doctorale Sciences Physiques et de l’Ingénieur (SPI) de l’Université de Bordeaux. La question centrale est la suivante : comment comprendre ce qu’un joueur cherche à faire à un instant donné, plutôt que seulement ce qu’il a aimé dans le passé, afin d’adapter son expérience en temps réel tout en donnant la priorité à sa protection ? YOUR RO LE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 Le sujet de thèse proposé est : « De la pertinence de l’item au pilotage de l’expérience : comprendre l’état de session d’un joueur pour personnaliser l’expérience en temps réel, sous contraintes de jeu responsable. » Le sujet sera précisé avec le ou la candidat·e retenu·e et le laboratoire académique avant le dépôt du dossier auprès de l’ANRT. Vos travaux de recherche s’articuleront autour de trois objectifs complémentaires : • Estimer un état de session latent à partir de séquences d’événements incomplètes, en tenant compte de l’incertitude et des changements de régime comportemental. • Dépasser le simple classement d’items et étudier une politique d’adaptation au niveau de l’expérience, capable de choisir entre plusieurs actions : recommander, informer, favoriser la découverte, ou ne rien pousser. • Intégrer le jeu responsable comme contrainte prioritaire de la décision, à partir de signaux précoces, incertains et évolutifs observés au cours de la session. Le travail s’appuiera sur la comparaison de deux environnements contrastés, les paris sportifs et le Casino, ainsi que sur un accès direct à des systèmes en cours de déploiement en production. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 Nous recherchons une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, qui apprécie les problèmes ouverts et souhaite relier recherche scientifique et impact concret. • Vous êtes titulaire, ou bientôt titulaire, d’un Master 2 ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur en statistiques, mathématiques appliquées, Data Science, Machine Learning, informatique, cognitique ou dans un domaine proche. • Vous êtes récemment diplômé·e ou disposez d’une à deux années d’expérience en industrie en Data Science, Machine Learning, R&D ou analyse de données, et souhaitez vous engager dans une thèse. • Vous avez une réelle appétence pour les statistiques, la modélisation et l’analyse de données comportementales. • Vous êtes intéressé·e par la cognition, les intentions, les comportements humains ou les interactions entre individus et systèmes numériques. • Vous savez formuler des hypothèses, construire un protocole expérimental et interpréter rigoureusement des résultats. • Vous êtes à l’aise avec Python et disposez de bonnes bases en SQL. • Vous communiquez clairement avec des interlocuteurs scientifiques, techniques et métier. • Vous êtes autonome, curieux·se, rigoureux·se et appréciez le travail collaboratif. Une expérience ou des connaissances en recommandation, personnalisation, modèles séquentiels ou probabilistes, états latents, quantification de l’incertitude, évaluation de systèmes adaptatifs, sciences cognitives ou jeu responsable seront appréciées. Une appétence pour le sport, le gaming ou les environnements produits est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous aurez d’abord un échange avec les Ressources Humaines, puis un entretien avec le Head of Data Science consacré à votre parcours, vos motivations et au sujet de thèse. Vous échangerez ensuite avec les encadrants académiques lors d’un entretien scientifique, avant un dernier entretien RH. Le processus pourra être adapté au profil du ou de la candidat·e et à l’avancement du projet CIFRE. Le sujet présenté constitue une base de travail : vos intérêts scientifiques et vos premières propositions contribueront à construire le programme de recherche final avec Betclic et le laboratoire académique. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 • Un CDI dès l’embauche dans le cadre d’une thèse CIFRE de 3 ans • Une rémunération attractive positionnée au niveau d’un poste de Junior Data Scientist chez Betclic • Un double encadrement industriel et académique au sein d’une équipe Data Science expérimentée et collaborative • Des données réelles, des systèmes en production et un environnement d’A/B testing • 25 jours de congés payés et 10 jours de RTT • Une carte Ticket Restaurant® créditée de 11 € par jour, dont 6 € pris en charge par Betclic • Une mutuelle santé prise en charge à 100 % pour vous et vos enfants • 50 % de remboursement des transports en commun ou une indemnité annuelle de mobilité durable • Un modèle de télétravail hybride et l’accès à un large catalogue de formation • Des cours de sport sur site, des événements internes et des locaux avec rooftop et vue sur la Cité du Vin CDI basé à Bordeaux Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.description: Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Who we are We’re Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands, including Betway and Jackpot City. We’re a powerhouse built on decades of expertise and we’re changing the game for good. Our mission is to give our customers a superclass entertainment experience. Who we’re looking for We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Super Group International, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar. Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary. Why we need you We’re building experiences that wow our customers – and that starts with bold, curious people who want to do work that matters. If you’re hungry to grow, excited by impact and ready for a challenge that will supercharge your career, this could be your moment. The ASO Specialist will drive mobile marketing efforts across 15+ brands, promoting iOS and Android apps with a global presence. Working alongside another ASO team member, this role is responsible for delivering impactful results through user acquisition strategies, conversion rate optimizations, and continuous support for app release and updates. What you’ll do You’ll take ownership of work that gives us our competitive edge, including: Own and optimize our apps across all markets, primarily on the App Store and Play Store. Develop and execute ASO strategies to enhance app visibility, increase downloads, and improve conversion rates. Optimize metadata including titles, descriptions, keywords, and visual assets, to boost visibility, rankings, and user acquisition. Run A/B tests on store assets and analyze results to inform ongoing optimization. Drive mobile innovation by staying up to date with the latest ASO trends, platform updates, and industry best practices. Conduct in-depth competitor analysis to uncover trends and growth opportunities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align ASO efforts with regular app release cycles and ensure readiness. Support the launch of new apps, features, and updates with tailored ASO strategies. Partner with product and marketing teams to drive promotions, including In-App Events. Manage multiple projects and timelines while coordinating with relevant stakeholders. Maintain strong and effective cross-team collaborations and relationships. Briefing, management, and research of projects in relevant systems. Maintain app store accounts and manage user access across all platforms. The conceptualization and implementation of ideas throughout the business. Ensure internal documentation and knowledge bases are regularly updated with new and existing processes. Manage communications with suppliers, agencies, and strategic partners. This list covers your core responsibilities – with plenty of room to stretch, explore and take on new challenges as we grow. What you’ll bring You’re someone who brings: Minimum 1 years’ working experience managing ASO on the App Store and Google Play, or relevant marketing experience. Experience managing apps on the App Store and Play Store Experience developing and executing successful ASO strategies that drive measurable results. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex ASO results into clear, actionable insights. Highly analytical with experience using ASO and app performance tools such as AppTweak, SensorTower, App Store Connect, and Google Play Console. Proficient in reporting and data visualization using tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Excel. Effective cross-functional collaborator, able to work seamlessly with performance marketing, creative, product, and analytics teams. Exceptional attention to detail, with strong organizational and prioritization skills Desirable skills you’ve got up your sleeve It would be great if you also have some the following skills: In-depth knowledge of sports betting markets, including odds calculation, betting types and market trends Previous experience in the online gaming or casino industry, with a strong understanding of player behaviour and industry regulations Familiarity with gambling regulations and compliance requirements in various jurisdictions, ensuring adherence to legal standards A passion for and knowledge of casino games. Experience in iGaming, regulated industries, or working with fast-paced digital products. Exposure to App Marketing platforms like AppsFlyer, Sensor Tower, App Annie etc Our values are non-negotiables Our culture is underpinned by core values that are linked to key behavioural competencies. Along with the below behavioural competencies, these are essential for all employees in order for you to embed in and drive our culture forward. These competencies are: Adaptability Ownership and accountability Initiating action Resilience Team orientation Integrity Innovation What you’ll get back We invest in your growth and wellbeing, so you can bring your best: Supergrowth is real here. Our learning and development programmes give you the tools, training and opportunities to level up fast. Your progress matters . Our Performance tool ensures you get meaningful feedback to support your development and superdrive your career. Support that has your back . Our Employee Assistance Programme offers resources for you and your family. Vitality Health Care Unum Dental Life Assurance & Income Protection Tusker car scheme Cycle to Work Retail discounts Ready to feel superclass? At Super Group, your experience matters. We’re honest, fair, and focused on helping you succeed – and your work will have real impact from day one. Game on! *Please note we will apply relevance to our Talent Management and Talent Development Programme as part of our recruitment process. *Shortlisted candidates may need to complete an assessment. This position requires trust and honesty it has access to customers financial details - therefore a credit and criminal record check will be conducted. The qualifications identified herein are an inherent job requirement; therefore, a qualification verification check will be done. By applying for this role, and supplying the necessary details, you hereby grant us permission to apply for these checks. This will be done in a confidential manner, and solely for the purposes of verification. Should you not hear from us within 2 weeks, please deem your application as unsuccessful. The perfect place to work, play and grow!

items.title: Engineering Manager (TLM, Agents)
items.description: Perplexity is seeking a TLM (Tech Lead Manager) to lead and grow our highly driven Agents engineering team. The Agents team consists of AI/ML, backend, and full-stack engineers who collaborate to build delightful agentic experiences within our Comet ecosystem https://www.perplexity.ai/comet. Our vision is to empower our users with AI agents that can faithfully actualize their intent, however and wherever expressed, through open-ended interactions with the world. As the Agents TLM, you will bring AI expertise, sharp product intuition, and strong engineering management skills to advance the frontier of what agents can accomplish for our millions of devoted users. You will lead, grow, and support a team in solving many open problems in AI, including: - Designing AI agents to navigate the digital world and perform increasingly valuable units of work for our users; - Training action and decision models that determine, based on complex multimodal states, how to accomplish user-specified objectives; - Providing consistently excellent experiences across desktop, mobile, headless cloud, and other environments through flexible abstractions and frictionless backgrounding; - Developing permission architectures, payload classifiers, and other methods to implement secure-by-design agentic capabilities; - Designing optimal data representations and modes of interaction between agents and their environments; - and much, much more. Develop rigorous interview pipelines and work closely with recruiting to source candidates. - Interface with the Perplexity co-founders to deliver strategic objectives that redefine what’s possible in the AI industry. items.title: Enforcement Operations Lead, Cloud Partners
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic's Safeguards team is responsible for enforcing our policies, protecting users, and ensuring our platform is not misused. A large and growing share of Claude usage reaches customers through our cloud partners: Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. As the Enforcement Operations Lead for Multi-Cloud, you'll own how Anthropic detects, reviews, and acts on misuse across those surfaces, where the partner owns the customer relationship and often the data path. You'll build the operating model, partner agreements, and documentation that make enforcement on every cloud consistent, auditable, and fast. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of coordinating across teams and companies to break new ground and drive work to completion. This work is deeply cross-functional. You'll partner closely with our product managers, policy experts, Safeguards engineering, Legal, and the trust & safety and operations teams across our Cloud partners to maintain a consistent and safe enforcement ecosystem. Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. Key responsibilities Own the end to end enforcement lifecycle on partner surfaces, from detection and review through action, customer communication, and appeal Define enforcement paths for each partner's operating model, including how actions are requested, executed, and confirmed when the partner controls the account Manage SLAs for review, escalation, and action, and evaluate performance against them on an ongoing basis Develop and maintain SOPs and escalation guides for all enforcement workflows, ensuring consistency across clouds Establish red-teaming, Quality processes, and operationalize shared metrics Stand up paired investigations with partner threat intelligence teams, including case referrals, indicator sharing, and paging for high severity incidents Own enforcement metrics across partner surfaces and report them to Safeguards leadership, partners, and regulators Minimum qualifications Extensive experience in trust and safety operations, enforcement, threat intelligence, or a related field Have managed external partner or vendor relationships where you did not control the other side's systems or priorities Comfortable working across policy, legal, engineering, and operations teams to translate requirements into practical workflows Experience building enforcement programs from the ground up, including SLAs, escalation paths, and quality measurement Highly organized, with a track record of maintaining rigorous documentation and SOPs in fast-moving environments Clear and precise communication, both in writing and verbally, across technical and non-technical audiences, including partner executives Energized by the challenge of building scalable systems in an environment where not everything is already figured out Care deeply about the responsible deployment of AI and the role enforcement operations plays in that mission Preferred qualifications Direct trust & safety, abuse, or security operations experience at AWS, GCP, or Azure, or at a company that ships through their marketplaces Experience designing incident response or escalation processes that span more than one company Familiarity with data access controls, audit requirements, or privacy constrained review environments Experience with law enforcement referrals, regulatory reporting, or compliance programs Background in AI safety, content moderation, fraud, or abuse detection systems Comfort working with data and metrics to inform operational decisions and surface trends to leadership The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $285,000 — $330,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Software Engineer, Consumer Health
items.description: OpenAI’s Health AI team is working to ensure that advances in AI meaningfully improve health for everyone. We build AI systems that help people better understand and navigate their health while setting a high bar for safety, reliability, privacy, and user trust. On the Consumer Health team, we’re building health experiences directly into ChatGPT. People can use ChatGPT to understand health information, prepare for appointments, make sense of changes over time, and have more informed conversations grounded in their own health context. Our work sits at the intersection of consumer product engineering, AI, and healthcare. We work closely with product, design, research, safety, privacy, and other ChatGPT teams to build experiences used at global scale. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for product-minded software engineers to build the next generation of consumer health experiences in ChatGPT. You will own products and features end-to-end, from early prototypes through polished experiences used by millions of people. We welcome specialists in mobile, frontend, or full-stack development; you can focus on the area where you have the most depth. This role is ideal for engineers who care deeply about craft and user experience, move quickly from idea to product, and are excited about making complex health information understandable and useful. Prior healthcare or AI experience is not required. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Design and build consumer health experiences across ChatGPT, including mobile, web, and full-stack product surfaces. - Own features end-to-end, from early product exploration and prototyping through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration. - Build intuitive experiences for helping people understand and interact with complex personal health information. - Work closely with product managers, designers, researchers, and safety experts to translate emerging AI capabilities into useful consumer products. - Build experiences that let people connect their medical records, health apps, and connected devices, explore their health over time, and get useful answers grounded in their personal context. - Develop reliable systems and interfaces for highly sensitive user data, with privacy and security built into the product experience. - Improve product quality, performance, reliability, and usability at ChatGPT scale. - Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them toward practical, high-quality solutions. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Are an exceptional product engineer who has shipped consumer-facing products and cares deeply about usability, performance, and craft. - Have 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software. - Have deep experience in at least one of mobile, frontend, or full-stack product development. - Enjoy working closely with design and product partners and contributing to product direction, not just implementation. - Can take ownership of ambiguous problems and move quickly from prototype to production while maintaining a high quality bar. - Are excited about the opportunity to use AI to help people better understand and manage their health. - Are thoughtful about the responsibilities that come with building products involving sensitive health information. BONUS IF YOU HAVE: - Experience building high-quality consumer products at significant scale. - Experience building AI-powered or conversational products. - Experience working with personal data, health data, wearables, or health platforms such as Apple Health. - Experience building products where privacy, safety, and user trust are core product requirements. - Previous experience in healthcare or health technology. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Safety Training research team aims to fundamentally advance our capabilities for precisely implementing safe behavior in AI models, and to leverage these advances to make OpenAI’s deployed models safe and beneficial. This requires a breadth of new ML research to address the growing set of safety challenges as AI becomes more powerful and used in more settings. Key focus areas include how to train nuanced safety behaviors, how to make the model robust to bad actors, how to address privacy and security risks, and how to make the model trustworthy in safety-critical situations. We seek to learn from deployment and distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re seeking a researcher to train and evaluate models for U.S. government use, with a focus on national security applications. You’ll advance safety post-training and robustness, helping models follow nuanced policies while preserving their usefulness and capabilities. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Research and implement methods for safety training, reinforcement learning, and adversarial robustness. - Develop evaluations, identify model failure modes, and use findings to improve training. - Work with research, engineering, security, and policy partners to support safe, reliable deployment. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Bring 4+ years of relevant AI safety research experience, including RLHF, adversarial training, or robustness. - Have a degree in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, and strong deep learning research or engineering skills. - Have experience improving model safety for deployment and enjoy collaborative research. - Are motivated by OpenAI’s mission and the responsible use of AI in safety-critical settings. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Legal team helps advance our mission by tackling novel legal issues in AI. Our team brings together professionals across technology, privacy, intellectual property, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. Our regulatory compliance work turns legal requirements into practical programs that support responsible AI development and deployment. About the Role As a Legal Program Manager focused on regulatory compliance, you will build and manage cross-functional programs that translate counsel’s guidance into practical, sustainable operations. Your initial focus may include content moderation and/or frontier AI governance, with the mix shaped by team priorities and your strengths. You will partner with internal and external counsel, other legal program managers, and technical and business teams to coordinate implementation, evidence collection, reporting, and ongoing compliance. You’ll build repeatable systems that scale across regulations, products, and jurisdictions, helping teams navigate emerging requirements with clarity and sound judgment. This full-time role is based in San Francisco, CA, or New York, NY. In this role, you will: - Lead regulatory compliance programs end to end: define scope, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and escalation paths, and drive execution with counsel and cross-functional partners. - Translate counsel’s regulatory guidance into repeatable workflows, controls, and documentation. Depending on your portfolio, this may include content moderation disclosures, transparency reporting, reporting and appeals workflows, or frontier AI model launch readiness, evaluation and risk-management evidence, and incident reporting. - Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, User Operations, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), Global Affairs, Communications, and Go-to-Market to align program priorities and deliverables. - Support regulatory inquiries, audits and investigations with counsel, organizing evidence and responses to support timely, accurate communication and reporting. - Maintain a reliable source of truth for obligations, controls, decisions, evidence, and reporting. Demonstrate compliance readiness and control effectiveness, and improve program timeliness and evidence quality. - Identify execution risks and compliance gaps, track remediation, and escalate blockers. Establish clear success measures and operating cadences, keeping legal conclusions subject to counsel’s review. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 6+ years of experience in program management, regulatory compliance, or related fields in a tech-forward or highly regulated environment, including relevant legal, regulatory, or compliance program experience. - Have experience working with an in-house legal team; regulatory matters experience and in-house technology experience are strongly preferred. - Have demonstrated experience building and scaling compliance programs, translating legal or regulatory requirements into operational workflows, and maintaining reliable documentation and evidence in partnership with counsel. - Take ownership of complex projects, set and achieve milestones, synthesize cross-functional input, and build trust across legal, technical, and business teams. - Bring strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. Exercise sound judgment under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and make progress through ambiguity. - Are resourceful and hands-on, with enthusiasm for AI technology and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technical concepts and navigate fast-moving technical environments. - Bring familiarity with content moderation, online safety, frontier AI governance, data governance, privacy, or emerging technology law as a plus.
